evals.name: adv-setup
evals.prompt: I'm starting a Marketplace flipping side hustle on top of a job and family. Set up a full GTD system for it: lists, contexts, a sample project with natural planning, and a Weekly Review checklist.
assertions: Sets up the list categories (projects, next actions, waiting for, calendar, someday/maybe, reference)
Runs natural planning on a project (purpose, outcome, brainstorm, organize, next actions)
Gives a Weekly Review checklist (get clear, get current, get creative)
Applies the two-minute rule and/or clarifying questions

evals.name: adv-horizons
evals.prompt: Map my life onto GTD's horizons of focus: I want to quit my job in 2 years and run my own business.
assertions: Names the horizons from Ground/runway through Horizon 5 (purpose/principles)
Places the 2-year goal at the right horizon (vision, ~3-5 years, or goals 1-2 years)
Gives concrete content at each horizon
